cases.name: Rainbow Ed25519 verification with native 64-bit limbs
cases.comment: Side-by-side counterpart to ed25519-rainbow. It verifies the identical Rainbow test vector and exposes the identical check(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,bytes9) ABI, but implements SHA-512, scalar reduction, field arithmetic, and point arithmetic entirely with uint64/int64 words and no mulmod, addmod, storage, precompile, or hashing host function.

inputs.comment: Allocate the account used to deploy and preflight the verifier.
Measured loop: each fresh sender submits the same independent Ed25519 verification as ed25519-rainbow.

steps.comment: Use an independent nonce chain so benchmark transactions can be submitted concurrently.
